text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly positive on the day, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 30 signals underlying unease despite the modest price stability, though the 3-point weekly improvement hints at a tentative shift away from deeper fear. Altcoins like SOL and BNB are outpacing the majors, indicating some risk appetite at the margin, while Bitcoin's 56.6% dominance and $34B daily volume reflect a market that remains cautious but not panicked.
